title: Digital Overload Spell
description: A surreal portrait of a blue-skinned woman with wild flowing red hair filled with floating numbers, letters, and wilted flowers. She points forward with an angry expression while three decaying humanoid figures sit at a wooden desk using glowing smartphones displaying error messages and code.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting of an angry blue-skinned woman with intense eyes and open mouth, her voluminous red hair flowing wildly and filled with floating numbers, letters, broken flowers and smartphones. She points directly forward. In the background three decaying zombie-like figures sit at a long wooden desk, hunched over and obsessively staring at glowing smartphones displaying code and error messages. Dark chaotic atmosphere with dripping paint effects and floating symbols throughout the composition.
